Interface ChaosMetricsSink

@Deprecated(since="2.0.0", forRemoval=true) public interface ChaosMetricsSink
Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
a second metrics API beside the events: the same count is chaos.applications of chaos-agent-micrometer's ChaosMeterBinder and of chaos-agent-opentelemetry, which a ChaosEventListener on APPLIED events can also produce for any other backend. This interface and chaos.effect.applied will be removed.
Bridge for emitting chaos activity as metrics to an external monitoring system.

Implement this interface to route chaos metrics to a metrics backend, and pass the implementation to the ChaosRuntime(Clock, ChaosMetricsSink) constructor. The default is NOOP: all calls are discarded.

Metrics emitted by the runtime:

  • chaos.effect.applied (counter) — incremented each time an effect fires. Tags: scenarioId, operation.

recordDuration(String, Duration, Map) is never called by the runtime.

Implementation contract: all methods must be non-blocking and must not throw. They are called on the thread performing the intercepted JVM operation.
